content:
mirella (product): quick sync — proposing GA readiness checklist for Dedicated v1.3. want to be explicit about what must be green before we flip GA flag. draft below, pls :eyes:

kevin (eng-sre): lgtm structure. what's the SLA target we expect to commit?

mirella (product): proposing SLA = 99.9% across monthly uptime for standard region; 99.95 for enterprise customers as a premium offering. also need documented error budget policy.

kevin (eng-sre): 99.9 is realistic if we have the fallback routing and capacity buffers. we need automated SLO alerts for: 1) p99 latency for generate endpoints 2) availability of dedicated pools 3) queue length/backpressure. alert owners must be named.

oliver (runtime): adding monitoring items — dashboards for per-model latency heatmaps, KV cache hit rate, batching efficiency. also payload-level error rates (model reject vs infra errors). i'll add a runbook prototype.

anika (docs): current docs status: Getting Started + Admin guide at 80%. missing: step-by-step dedicated onboarding (VPC peering, NAT rules), SLA page, and failover playbook. ETA for drafts: 5 business days if eng provides runbook snippets.

raj (support): support readiness: we need runbooks and playbooks + training session for L2 oncall. propose internal two-hour lab and a 1-pager triage flow. also confirm on-call rotation for first 90 days post-GA.

compliance-bot: note: contract template must include SLA language and credits calculation. legal review required for the enterprise SLA wording.

mirella (product): good call. here's the high-level GA checklist i want agreement on (one-line items):

- SLA & Error Budget defined and included in contract (owner: kevin + legal)
- Core docs: Getting Started, Admin, SLA, Failover Playbook, Upgrade notes (owner: anika)
- Support: L2 training, runbooks, triage 1-pager, escalation matrix (owner: raj)
- Monitoring: dashboards + automated alerts + SLO export (owner: oliver)
- Pricing: published pricing tiers + overage rules + promo for early adopters (owner: marketing — pinging separately)
- Rollout plan: staged GA with canary, 1-week monitor window, auto-fallback to hosted API (owner: eng leads)
- Metrics: success criteria — <5% rollback risk, p95 latency <200ms for cached paths, error budget burn <10% in first month

kevin (eng-sre): quick SLA snippet suggestion for contracts:

```
SLA: Redwood Dedicated will provide 99.9% monthly uptime. If uptime falls below SLA, customer will receive service credits pro-rated to downtime. Error budget calculation: (1 - uptime) * 30 days. Exceptions: Force majeure, customer misconfig, scheduled maintenance with 72h notice.
```

anika (docs): i'll draft an SLA explainer page that includes sample calculations and FAQ.

raj (support): for training want to confirm who from eng will join the lab — @oliver? @kevin? need hands-on to walk through failure modes.

oliver (runtime): i'll join the lab. can also prepare a simulated incident runbook for the session.

mirella (product): timeline proposal: finalize checklist owners and deliverables by EOD next wed (1750640000). then a dry-run GA canary next week after docs+runbooks are in.

kevin (eng-sre): one more infra ask: need capacity gating in code to prevent oversubscription during canary. i'll create a PR and mark it as release-blocker if not merged.

compliance-bot: reminder: add KMS/HSM integration note for Private customers to the admin guide.

anika (docs): noted — adding a dedicated section.

mirella (product): OK — owners: kevin = SLA & infra gating; anika = docs; raj = support training + playbooks; oliver = monitoring + runbook; i'll own rollout plan + metrics. marketing to confirm pricing publish date by EOD Friday.

raj (support): i'll schedule the L2 lab and share calendar invites, will also draft the 1-pager and post here when ready. :white_check_mark:

mirella (product): thanks team — if nobody objects i'll lock this checklist and start external comms prep. call out blockers here.

kevin (eng-sre): no objections from me. keeping an eye on the PRs.

oliver (runtime): no objections. will ping when dashboards are staged in staging cluster.

anika (docs): will post first draft by Tue EOD.

compliance-bot: legal review queued — expect comments within 3 business days.

mirella (product): perfect. next sync if needed but let's keep updates in-thread. :rocket:
